CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 05 / 13

Tax revenue and deadweight loss

Lost surplus versus tax receipts剩餘損失與稅收

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain that a tax may reduce consumer and producer surplus by more than the government collects; the difference is DWL.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

CS 與 PS 的總減少等於政府收入加 DWL。稅收只是轉到政府，超出稅收的損失才使總剩餘下降。

The reduction in CS plus PS equals government revenue plus DWL in the standard model. Revenue is transferred to government; DWL is the remaining loss in total surplus.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Buyers and sellers jointly lose 500; government receives 350. DWL=500−350=150. 無謂損失為一百五十。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

CS+PS falls by 120 and tax revenue is 90. DWL? 私人剩餘跌一百二十、稅收九十？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
